column1: # Trips abroad, wave 1 (CEO 29.10): catalogue country, ISO 3166-2 region code («*» = every region of the country
# without its own row), IANA time zone, UTC offset on 2026-10-29, source. Hand-written from the IANA tz database
# (zone1970.tab and the zone rules, tzdata 2026e) — not from memory; `build_catalogue.py --country` checks every
# region against Wikidata P421 (`country_check.json`) and writes the result to catalogue_meta.tzCheck. None of
# these countries observes DST in 2026.
# Kazakhstan: zone1970.tab still lists seven KZ zones (Asia/Almaty «most of Kazakhstan», Asia/Qyzylorda,
# Asia/Qostanay, Asia/Aqtobe, Asia/Aqtau, Asia/Atyrau, Asia/Oral), but since 2024-03-01 all of them are UTC+5:
# the country has ONE offset, not two. A region row may still name its own zone once the CI report lists the
# region codes Wikidata uses (the old letter codes or the new numeric ones of ISO 3166-2:KZ).
# Uzbekistan: Asia/Tashkent (east) and Asia/Samarkand (west) are both UTC+5.
# Abkhazia: the tz database has no zone of its own (it files Abkhazia under GE, Asia/Tbilisi, UTC+4); Abkhazia
# keeps Moscow time de facto. Europe/Moscow here; the tzCheck of the AB build compares it with Wikidata P421.
